card.name: Space after maintenance-therapy headings
card.fires_on: A blank space token right after a maintenance-therapy heading or phrase, just before a dose or duration number. Seen mostly in dosing tables for omeprazole and GERD healing.

modes.label: Maintenance heading in dose table
modes.description: Space after a heading like Maintenance of Healing of EE, before the dose.
modes.example: Maintenance of Healing of EE due to Acid-Mediated GERD<< >>20 mg once daily Dosage reduction

modes.label: Long-term therapy duration
modes.description: Space after maintenance or continued therapy wording, before a length of time.
modes.example: It is appropriate to continue maintenance therapy<< >>3 months or longer to lessen the possibility

card.writes: It pushes toward words about long or permanent duration, like lifelong and lifetime.
card.plain: It fires on the gap after a maintenance-treatment heading, where a dose or length of treatment comes next.
